verdict.rationale: BugSnag provides release-correlated error tracking, stability trend monitoring, and views of newly introduced errors and error grouping, which support elements of trend dashboards (bugsnag-docs-3, bugsnag-docs-4, bugsnag-docs-5, bugsnag-docs-25, bugsnag-docs-26, bugsnag-docs-29), and community feedback praises the dashboard experience (bugsnag-comm-6, bugsnag-comm-7). However, there is no explicit evidence of a cross-project/cross-team aggregated view or a dedicated 'top regressions' leaderboard spanning multiple teams — missing for 10: cross-project/team rollup dashboards, explicit 'top regressions' ranking feature, and independent validation of multi-team analytics at scale.
